data.content_ref: inline:The 'error-correction trajectory' (SRC_003) reduces to a measure of 'cognitive scaffold efficacy' when viewed through the lens of the 'Checklist-Intuition Gap' (SCR_001); it is refuted if the same trajectory is observed in experts using the checklist, implying the gain is a property of the protocol (variance reduction) rather than the panel's non-expert diversity.
